newsitem.title: GUYANA: CRICKET-WEST INDIES NAME 13 FOR FIRST TWO ONE-DAYERS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WEST INDIES NAME 13 FOR FIRST TWO ONE-DAYERS.

text.p: GEORGETOWN, Guyana, April 20, Reuter - West Indies on Sunday named a 13-man squad for the first two of four one-day matches against India. They are being staged in Trinidad on April 26 and 27.

Courtney Walsh (captain), Brian Lara, Stuart Williams, Carl Hooper, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Roland Holder, Jimmy Adams, Phil Simmons, Courtney Browne, Ottis Gibson, Franklyn Rose, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose.
